fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-3295c0e4 at 6b7d571f (attempt 2). Read the diff: freebytes_test.go adds pinFreeBytes (RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES=1099511627776 beside RHIZA_TEST_NOW) and setFreeBytes; TestMain swaps diskFreeBytes (daemon.go, was daemon.FreeBytes) for a panic; the schedule harness drops MinFree "0" and schedHealthCtx drops the minFree=0 stub, both pinning instead; attempt 2 pins daemonRepo, web_root and usage_learn ctxs, and the two RHIZA_TEST_NOW-free web listener tests turn minFree/trimGoCache off. Ran: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestDaemonPollStartsEachProjectsSchedule|TestDaemonScheduleUnresolvedWorkflow|TestHealthSchedulesPart|TestFreeBytesOverride' -count=1 -> ok, all four PASS. TestFreeBytesOverride sets 5 GiB and sees daemonDiskLow low and health's disk part HealthBad. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(health|daemon-notify-disk-low)' -count=1 -> ok. Mutation check in a scratch worktree with the RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES case removed from pinFreeBytes: each of the three schedule/health tests, run alone, fails with the panic 'test read the host's real free disk space'. Attempt 1's finding f1 is fixed: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -count=1 -timeout 30m -v gives 531 PASS lines, no --- FAIL and no free-disk panic, ending in PASS. The package then reports FAIL only from rootguard: ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json changed, a file the live rhiza-root.service (active on this VM) writes, unrelated to this diff. An earlier run under the default 600s timeout timed out under load 8 on 4 cores; TestLinkEndpointKinds alone took 119s.
